title: Core Public Export Boundary Review
summary: Review and narrow the Core package export boundary so Editor and Backend consume approved surfaces instead of accidental internals.
expectedOutput: A Core-owned boundary decision or implementation patch with tests showing which public package surfaces are supported for Editor and Backend consumers.
riskSummary: The current Core root entrypoint exports many layout, authoring, generation, renderer, pagination, and table modules before the release boundary is complete.
